description:
`ProfileOrigin` is replaced by the worktree-relative directory path it wraps, and a package origin serializes as that path in results, events and schemas.

## Background

`ProfileOrigin` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1130`) has one variant, `Directory(RootRelativePath)`, and serializes as a tagged object (`{"source": "directory", "location": ...}`). It is destructured irrefutably at `crates/jit/src/main.rs:1176` and read across the composition, application, difference, package-capture, initialization, materialization, init and validate modules, and in the derived-state repair and cutover tests. Profile results that carry an origin reach the published schemas, human-readable output and the MCP integration tests (`mcp-server/test-integration.js`). Line numbers are at the investigation baseline. The wire change needs no migration: no released format exists (`@/inv/canonical-cutover`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No `ProfileOrigin` enum remains; each former use holds the worktree-relative directory path.
- [hard] REQ-02: A package origin serializes as its worktree-relative directory path, and the published schemas say so.
- [hard] REQ-03: Human-readable output names the origin directory as before.
- [hard] REQ-04: The MCP integration tests and the profile publication tests pass over the new origin shape.
title: Serialize a profile origin as its directory path
